thread:
Maya: Heads-up — CloudVendor invoice for March includes a ~$45,120 line item labeled 'GPU promo credit' with no project tags. Need attribution before 2026-04-01 close. CSV uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood/example (column name: allocation_hint).

billing-bot: [automated] UNLABELED GPU CREDIT detected: $45,120 (invoice CV-2026-03-88). Suggested owners: playground, sandbox, partner-catalyst. Run `billing:resolve --suggest` to generate candidate allocations.

Ajay: I can run a usage correlation against compute logs. Share the invoice id (got it) and the CSV — I'll try to match by allocation_id, start/end timestamps, and GPU instance IDs.

Maya: Thanks @Ajay. CSV is in the drive link above. Note: a chunk of rows have 'partner_trial' in allocation_hint but no customer_id; suspect Catalyst promo landed as a single credit line.

Oliver: I'll run a SQL that looks for: 1) GPU instances with >72h runtime in March, 2) jobs with tags missing but with owner labels in K8s metadata, and 3) any committed usage that overlaps the credit window. Pulling now.

Sarah: FYI infra — there were two auto-tagging jobs that failed for account 'playground' between 2026-03-12 and 2026-03-14 (INF-2219). That could explain some untagged spend. I've reopened the infra ticket and flagged for backfill.

Ajay: Quick match update: ~28k matched to 'dedicated-research' (team: ML-Research), ~10k matched to 'partner-catalyst' based on client IDs, remainder ~7,120 USD unclear. I'm pushing a draft attribution CSV to the drive: /credit-attrib/draft/CV-2026-03-88-attrib.csv.

Maya: Can we add a confidence column (high/med/low) and owner field for each row? Finance needs owner + one-line justification to approve reassignments. I'll prepare the approval template once you have owners.

Oliver: Done — added 'confidence' and a short 'how_matched' note for each row. For low-confidence rows I included the nearest matching metadata (pod_name, node_id, start_ts). File: /credit-attrib/1767008901-results.csv.

Ajay: For the low-confidence $7k, my hypothesis is ephemeral training jobs spawned by sandbox CI that lost tagging after a flag flip in the deploy pipeline. Sarah, can infra backfill tags from K8s pod labels for 03/10-03/20? If so, we can bump confidence to 'medium' or 'high'.

Sarah: Yes — we can backfill by reconciling pod labels with job manifests and image digests. I'll create a backfill script and PR today, ETA EOD. Will post the run log here when complete.

Maya: Perfect. Once the backfill and updated attribution are in, I'll review and sign off. Finance approval required by 2026-04-01 to close the month. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Status update recorded: tentative allocation submitted for invoice CV-2026-03-88. Next step: Finance approval by 2026-04-01.
